title: Launcher run registration reports registered-but-not-indexed for a local Engram session's focused or full run in an explicitly named root
outcome: A focused launcher run started by a local session in a source root it named before the run is indexed by the host, with native wait available, or the launcher states the exact reason it is not (for example, the naming is not yet effective) so the agent can act on it.
acceptance: Launcher run registration reports registered-but-not-indexed for a local Engram session's focused run in an explicitly named root is done
